name: Secretary
overview: The role of the secretary in Scripture is depicted as a vital administrative and record-keeping position, closely associated with scribes and recorders who managed important affairs of the kingdom and temple. Figures such as Seraiah, Jehoshaphat, and others served as secretaries or scribes, overseeing financial matters and documenting royal and priestly activities, as seen in the oversight of temple funds and repairs during the reigns of David and later kings. These secretaries ensured accountability and order, reflecting the importance of faithful stewardship and diligent service in God’s work.
